name: North Italia (Mountain View Village · Herriman/Riverton) Fresh Pasta Bolognese & Margherita Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: North Italia (Mountain View Village · Riverton / Herriman / South Jordan, UT)
whyItWorks: Minutes from Holiday Inn Express Herriman at Mountain View Village: North Italia makes fresh daily egg pasta in-house, and their braised Bolognese or plain butter/parmesan pasta is soft and low-fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Traditional Bolognese (or fresh trofie/tagliatelle pasta with butter/olive oil, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and grilled chicken/salmon) or the Margherita Pizza with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Ask to hold spicy calabrian chilies on any pasta or pizza dish
